description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Ayame (Ice)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Ayame (Ice)
description.text: Increases [Ice Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Samurai abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Ayame (Ice) after using three Samurai abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Tachi: Gekko+
description.text: Six single attacks (1.20 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, 100% additional critical chance if user has [Retaliate] or [High Retaliate]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Ayame (Ice)
description.text: Grants [Deadly Strikes +20% 1], [Damage Cap +10000 1], [Samurai +50% Boost 1] and [Samurai Ability Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
